sections.text_helper: Section 16.6.12 "EXTI privilege configuration register 2 (EXTI_PRIVCFGR2)" in chapter 16 (Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 461.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x038
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
This register provides privileged write access protection. An unprivileged read returns the
register data.
Contains only register bits for privilege capable input events.
Bits 31:8 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 7:0 PRIVx: Privilege enable on event input x (x = 39 to 32)
0: Event privilege disabled (unprivileged)
1: Event privilege enabled (privileged)

fields.name: Res.
fields.description: Reserved, must be kept at reset value.

fields.name: PRIVx
fields.description: Privilege enable on event input x (x = 39 to 32)
